notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.4 HALLOWEEN
notes.notes:
Hello! Halloween is here, and we've brought you a new update full of treats - the tricks are left to the creatures of Millennium Park ;)

UPDATED BAN SYSTEM
When banning an item on the Level Up screen, you'll still be able to choose one of the other selected items. We believe this option will now be much more useful without impacting the players' build.

THEMED SCENERY
Millennium Park is fully decorated to celebrate this spooky season!

See you in the next update!

notes.title: BUG FIX 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have received reports from some players experiencing issues with game startup. After investigating, we identified the error and have already fixed it. It was related to retrieving the language settings from players' Steam accounts.

We hope everyone can now enjoy this new update. We'll continue to keep an eye on your feedback! ;)
